---
title: "Module 01: Assemble single-cell RNA-seq Seurat object"
output: html_document
---

```{r}

#==============================================================================
# MODULE 01 — Assemble single-cell RNA-seq Seurat object
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Import raw 10x Genomics count matrices for three scRNA-seq samples,
#   construct sample-level Seurat objects, harmonize the gene feature space,
#   merge the samples, calculate basic QC metadata, validate the merged object,
#   and save reproducible checkpoint objects for downstream analysis.
#
# Input:
#   data/raw/single_cell_raw/
#
# Expected files:
#   GSM9021009_C2_S2_matrix.mtx.gz
#   GSM9021009_C2_S2_features.tsv.gz
#   GSM9021009_C2_S2_barcodes.tsv.gz
#
#   GSM9021010_N1_S3_matrix.mtx.gz
#   GSM9021010_N1_S3_features.tsv.gz
#   GSM9021010_N1_S3_barcodes.tsv.gz
#
#   GSM9021011_N2_S4_matrix.mtx.gz
#   GSM9021011_N2_S4_features.tsv.gz
#   GSM9021011_N2_S4_barcodes.tsv.gz
#
# Output:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     C2_S2_raw_seurat.rds
#     N1_S3_raw_seurat.rds
#     N2_S4_raw_seurat.rds
#     GSE298688_merged_raw_seurat.rds
#
# Notes:
#   - This module performs only minimal filtering during CreateSeuratObject().
#   - Detailed QC filtering is performed in Module 02.
#   - No normalization, scaling, PCA, clustering, or integration is performed.
#   - Mouse mitochondrial genes are identified with the "^mt-" pattern.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

input_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "single_cell_raw"
)

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)

dir.create(
  processed_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define sample metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample = c(
    "C2_S2",
    "N1_S3",
    "N2_S4"
  ),
  gsm = c(
    "GSM9021009",
    "GSM9021010",
    "GSM9021011"
  ),
  condition = c(
    "Control",
    "Niacin",
    "Niacin"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 01 — Single-cell Seurat object assembly\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:   ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Input directory:   ", input_directory, "\n",
  "Output directory:  ", processed_directory, "\n",
  "Samples:           ", nrow(sample_info), "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(sample_info)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Validate input directory
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!dir.exists(input_directory)) {
  stop(
    "Single-cell input directory was not found:\n",
    input_directory
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Function to create one sample-level Seurat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

create_seurat_object <- function(
    gsm,
    sample_name,
    condition,
    input_directory
) {

  cat(
    "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "Loading sample: ", sample_name, "\n",
    "GEO sample:     ", gsm, "\n",
    "Condition:      ", condition, "\n",
    "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  matrix_file <- file.path(
    input_directory,
    paste0(
      gsm,
      "_",
      sample_name,
      "_matrix.mtx.gz"
    )
  )

  features_file <- file.path(
    input_directory,
    paste0(
      gsm,
      "_",
      sample_name,
      "_features.tsv.gz"
    )
  )

  barcodes_file <- file.path(
    input_directory,
    paste0(
      gsm,
      "_",
      sample_name,
      "_barcodes.tsv.gz"
    )
  )


  required_files <- c(
    matrix_file,
    features_file,
    barcodes_file
  )


  missing_files <- required_files[
    !file.exists(required_files)
  ]


  if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required 10x input file(s) for sample ",
      sample_name,
      ":\n",
      paste(
        missing_files,
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    )
  }


  cat(
    "Input files confirmed.\n"
  )


  # Read raw sparse count matrix
  counts <- Seurat::ReadMtx(
    mtx = matrix_file,
    features = features_file,
    cells = barcodes_file,
    feature.column = 2
  )


  cat(
    "Raw matrix dimensions:\n",
    "  Genes: ", nrow(counts), "\n",
    "  Cells: ", ncol(counts), "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # Create Seurat object with minimal initial filtering
  seurat_object <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    project = sample_name,
    min.cells = 3,
    min.features = 200
  )


  # Add sample-level metadata
  seurat_object$sample <- sample_name
  seurat_object$condition <- condition
  seurat_object$GSM <- gsm


  cat(
    "Seurat object created:\n",
    "  Genes retained: ", nrow(seurat_object), "\n",
    "  Cells retained: ", ncol(seurat_object), "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  return(seurat_object)
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Create individual Seurat objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

C2_S2 <- create_seurat_object(
  gsm = "GSM9021009",
  sample_name = "C2_S2",
  condition = "Control",
  input_directory = input_directory
)

N1_S3 <- create_seurat_object(
  gsm = "GSM9021010",
  sample_name = "N1_S3",
  condition = "Niacin",
  input_directory = input_directory
)

N2_S4 <- create_seurat_object(
  gsm = "GSM9021011",
  sample_name = "N2_S4",
  condition = "Niacin",
  input_directory = input_directory
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Validate individual objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

individual_objects <- list(
  C2_S2 = C2_S2,
  N1_S3 = N1_S3,
  N2_S4 = N2_S4
)


for (sample_name in names(individual_objects)) {

  object <- individual_objects[[sample_name]]


  if (!inherits(object, "Seurat")) {
    stop(
      sample_name,
      " is not a valid Seurat object."
    )
  }


  if (ncol(object) == 0) {
    stop(
      sample_name,
      " contains zero cells."
    )
  }


  if (nrow(object) == 0) {
    stop(
      sample_name,
      " contains zero genes."
    )
  }


  if (anyDuplicated(rownames(object)) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicated gene names detected in ",
      sample_name,
      "."
    )
  }


  if (anyDuplicated(colnames(object)) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicated cell barcodes detected in ",
      sample_name,
      "."
    )
  }
}


cat(
  "\nIndividual Seurat object validation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Harmonize genes across samples
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Harmonizing gene features across samples\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


common_genes <- sort(
  Reduce(
    intersect,
    lapply(
      individual_objects,
      rownames
    )
  )
)


if (length(common_genes) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No genes were shared across all three samples."
  )
}


cat(
  "Genes before harmonization:\n",
  "  C2_S2: ", nrow(C2_S2), "\n",
  "  N1_S3: ", nrow(N1_S3), "\n",
  "  N2_S4: ", nrow(N2_S4), "\n",
  "\n",
  "Shared genes retained: ",
  length(common_genes),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


C2_S2 <- subset(
  C2_S2,
  features = common_genes
)

N1_S3 <- subset(
  N1_S3,
  features = common_genes
)

N2_S4 <- subset(
  N2_S4,
  features = common_genes
)


if (
  !identical(
    rownames(C2_S2),
    rownames(N1_S3)
  ) ||
  !identical(
    rownames(C2_S2),
    rownames(N2_S4)
  )
) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Gene harmonization failed:",
      "feature names or feature ordering",
      "do not match across samples."
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "Gene harmonization completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Merge sample-level Seurat objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Merging Seurat objects\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell_merged <- merge(
  x = C2_S2,
  y = list(
    N1_S3,
    N2_S4
  ),
  add.cell.ids = c(
    "C2_S2",
    "N1_S3",
    "N2_S4"
  ),
  project = "GSE298688"
)


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  single_cell_merged
) <- "RNA"


cat(
  "Merged object created:\n",
  "  Genes:   ", nrow(single_cell_merged), "\n",
  "  Cells:   ", ncol(single_cell_merged), "\n",
  "  Samples: ",
  length(
    unique(
      single_cell_merged$sample
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nCell counts by sample and condition:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    single_cell_merged$sample,
    single_cell_merged$condition
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Calculate basic QC metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Calculating basic QC metadata\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


# Mouse mitochondrial genes generally begin with "mt-".
# For human data, this pattern is typically "^MT-".
single_cell_merged[["percent.mt"]] <- Seurat::PercentageFeatureSet(
  single_cell_merged,
  pattern = "^mt-"
)


mitochondrial_genes <- grep(
  pattern = "^mt-",
  x = rownames(single_cell_merged),
  value = TRUE
)


cat(
  "Mitochondrial genes detected: ",
  length(mitochondrial_genes),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


if (length(mitochondrial_genes) == 0) {
  warning(
    paste(
      "No mitochondrial genes matched '^mt-'.",
      "Confirm the gene naming convention before QC filtering."
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Validate merged object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating merged Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


if (!inherits(single_cell_merged, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Merged object is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}


if (anyDuplicated(rownames(single_cell_merged)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated gene names detected in merged object."
  )
}


if (anyDuplicated(colnames(single_cell_merged)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated cell barcodes detected in merged object."
  )
}


required_metadata <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "GSM",
  "nCount_RNA",
  "nFeature_RNA",
  "percent.mt"
)


missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(
    single_cell_merged@meta.data
  )
)


if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required metadata column(s) missing from merged object:\n",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


if (
  any(
    is.na(
      single_cell_merged@meta.data[
        ,
        required_metadata
      ]
    )
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Missing values detected in required metadata columns."
  )
}


expected_samples <- c(
  "C2_S2",
  "N1_S3",
  "N2_S4"
)


observed_samples <- sort(
  unique(
    single_cell_merged$sample
  )
)


if (
  !identical(
    sort(expected_samples),
    observed_samples
  )
) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Unexpected sample identities detected.",
      "Expected:",
      paste(
        expected_samples,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      "Observed:",
      paste(
        observed_samples,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "Merged object validation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Print basic QC summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Basic QC summary before detailed filtering\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


print(
  summary(
    single_cell_merged@meta.data[
      ,
      c(
        "nCount_RNA",
        "nFeature_RNA",
        "percent.mt"
      )
    ]
  )
)


cat(
  "\nCells per sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    single_cell_merged$sample
  )
)


cat(
  "\nCells per condition:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    single_cell_merged$condition
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Define output files
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

C2_S2_output_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "C2_S2_raw_seurat.rds"
)

N1_S3_output_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "N1_S3_raw_seurat.rds"
)

N2_S4_output_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "N2_S4_raw_seurat.rds"
)

merged_output_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_merged_raw_seurat.rds"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Save sample-level and merged Seurat objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Saving Seurat objects\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


saveRDS(
  C2_S2,
  C2_S2_output_file
)

saveRDS(
  N1_S3,
  N1_S3_output_file
)

saveRDS(
  N2_S4,
  N2_S4_output_file
)

saveRDS(
  single_cell_merged,
  merged_output_file
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Validate saved files
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

saved_files <- c(
  C2_S2_output_file,
  N1_S3_output_file,
  N2_S4_output_file,
  merged_output_file
)


missing_saved_files <- saved_files[
  !file.exists(saved_files)
]


if (length(missing_saved_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected output files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_saved_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "All expected Seurat objects were saved successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Final module summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 01 COMPLETE — Single-cell Seurat assembly\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Final object: GSE298688_merged_raw_seurat.rds\n",
  "\n",
  "Genes:       ", nrow(single_cell_merged), "\n",
  "Cells:       ", ncol(single_cell_merged), "\n",
  "Samples:     ",
  length(
    unique(
      single_cell_merged$sample
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "\n",
  "Primary output:\n",
  "  ", merged_output_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Sample-level checkpoints:\n",
  "  ", C2_S2_output_file, "\n",
  "  ", N1_S3_output_file, "\n",
  "  ", N2_S4_output_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Next module:\n",
  "  02_seurat_qc_filtering.Rmd\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

```
